messages:
Jake (NovaCorp): Hey team — just finished SSO onboarding with Azure AD for our account, but we can't find any API keys in the console and calls with the service account token return 403. Can someone help? We need the keys to test the integration today.
Maya K.: sorry you're blocked! can you paste the error you see and the project/org id from the console? also which flow did you use (SAML or OIDC)?
Jake (NovaCorp): We're on SAML. Error from our side (curl):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-2","prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"permission_denied\", \"message\":\"project not found or access denied\"}
```
Console org id: org_9802, project id shown in UI: proj-nova-01 (but when we list projects via API it doesn't show our project at all).
Maya K.: thanks. could be an onboarding mapping issue — sometimes the SAML assertion's group/project attribute isn't mapped and the system creates the tenant but doesn't attach a project. i'll loop in eng to check the backend mapping. 
Maya K.: @Samir R. can you look up org_9802 tenancy records and the SAML mapping for NovaCorp? looks like customer not seeing keys because project wasn't created/linked.
Samir R.: on it. give me a sec to query the onboarding service.
PlatformBot: Deploy: onboarding-service v3.14 rolled out 2026-03-02 14:12 UTC. No active incidents.
Samir R.: ok pulled the record. onboarding log shows SAML assertion arrived with attribute `redwood_project` empty (assertion had `groups` only). the service created an org but skipped project creation. i've flagged the tenant row: tenant_id=tn_44b1, org_id=org_9802, projects=[]
Samir R.: two remediation paths: 1) manually create the project and attach an API key (quickest), 2) re-run the SSO onboarding with proper attribute mapping (longer, fixes root cause). which do you prefer?
Jake (NovaCorp): need quick — can you create a key and we can rotate later? also want to know why the console shows proj-nova-01 but API listing doesn't.
Samir R.: console UI reading a cached project metadata from the signup flow — that was a placeholder name, not a real project row (UI bug). i'll create a temporary project and a scoped API key now and share a secure link.
Eli: heads-up — creating API keys for customers needs approval if the project isn't owned by billing — tagging @Olivia B. for billing consent.
Olivia B.: fine to provision a temporary key for support troubleshooting. make it time-limited (48h) and tag billing_note:temp_key_support. no charges until they start calls beyond trial.
Samir R.: creating...
Samir R.: done. created project `proj-nova-temp-176315` under org_9802 and generated a temporary key with minimal scopes (generation, embeddings). TTL set 48h. Sharing via one-time secure link.
Samir R.: link (expiring): https://secrets.redwood.internal/secret/eyJhbGci... (internal-only) — Jake, i'll send the same via your support email, don't paste here.
Jake (NovaCorp): received the email and the key works! calls succeed now. thanks. quick note: how do we prevent this for other SSO customers?
Maya K.: thanks for verifying. Samir, can you add a follow-up ticket for dev to gracefully handle empty `redwood_project` (create default project OR surface a clear onboarding error) and fix the console caching?
Samir R.: filed ticket RDW-2387: onboarding should validate required SAML attributes and create a default project when missing; consoles should reflect final persisted state not placeholder. assigned to eng-onboarding team. added acceptance criteria and a repro.
Samir R.: root cause: some Azure AD templates don't map custom attributes by default. customers using those templates can omit the project attribute.
Maya K.: devex note: include the mapping example in onboarding docs (SAML attribute name `redwood_project` or group mapping). i'll draft a snippet.
Maya K.: snippet to add to docs for Azure AD SAML claims:
```
Name: redwood_project
Source: user/group claim or custom extension
Format: string (project-id)
Example value: proj-nova-01
```
Samir R.: also adding a small migration to populate project for recent tenants created with empty projects where the customer provided a UI project name. PR 1025 created, will be included in the next patch.
Olivia B.: billing follow-up: if they keep this temp key and generate heavy usage, we'll bill as normal. i've added a billing flag to the tenant to allow a 72h trial buffer.
Jake (NovaCorp): appreciated. one more thing — what about SSO provisioning scope? the key we got seems limited — can we get full scopes for our integration?
Maya K.: create a support ticket for production keys once SSO mapping is fixed. process: re-run onboarding (or have eng attach project), then create prod key scoped to their needs. include required scopes in request (e.g., `generation:write`, `embeddings:read`, `admin:projects`).
Samir R.: ETA for permanent fix: quick validation + console fix goes out in patch deploy tomorrow morning (2026-03-16 06:00 UTC). migration + template docs by end of week.
PlatformBot: Incident note: scheduled patch deploy 2026-03-16 06:00 UTC — onboarding-service v3.15.
Jake (NovaCorp): thanks all. can you leave notes in the tenant about the temporary key and steps we did? i'll close this thread after we see the migration.
Samir R.: added note to tenant audit log: temporary key provisioned by support, billing flag added, ticket RDW-2387 created.
Maya K.: follow-up: i'll DM you the doc snippet and opening checklist for full prod key provisioning. please reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
Jake (NovaCorp): will do. really appreciate the fast turnaround!
Olivia B.: marking billing flag as advisory complete.
Eli: closing loop from SRE — no infra changes required, just onboarding service fixes. monitoring alert added for unusual tenant creations without projects.
